scope: Read-only analysis of completed explicit reports. No workload execution. Ratios are candidate/baseline within matching rounds; resource-gate failures retained. Candidate identity in each source report remains authoritative.

paired.scope: candidate/baseline ratios within randomized serial paired rounds; lower is better

summary.performance_note: descriptive local fixture measurement; pacing, observer or producer may cap throughput

calibration.scope: unparsed raw stream drain; producer/reader diagnostic only

full_output_validation.performance_note: descriptive local fixture measurement; pacing, observer or producer may cap throughput

backlog.definition: materialized generated records minus sink accepted unique events; includes at most one bounded producer batch before append

limits: one append-only JSONL source; no rotation, truncation, symlink or file-discovery coverage
source/state use the selected output filesystem; tmpfs changes fsync costs
single bounded HTTP sink process; histogram is producer-to-acceptance latency, not network-only latency
collector CPU includes controller threads, excluding separate writer/sink processes
same-state rejection is checked while idle; different-state concurrency is not exercised
controlled accept-before-503 on one event batch models at-least-once replay, not arbitrary kill/crash timing or server deduplication
Rust collector only; there is no Go ingest feature to compare

latency.overflow_note: null percentile means empty histogram or above final finite bin

Five paired rounds on shared host are descriptive, without population confidence claims.
Ingest resource gate failed because RSS regression exceeded5%; compatibility and retry/split probes passed.

Fault ack-loss deliberately includes20 exact replay duplicates; it is at-least-once delivery.

Small-workload native RSS increase and repeated-large user CPU overhead remain unresolved pending queued mapping/inline diagnostics.
